note: Same 12 questions, now asked for a worker in California with California law loaded. Expectations are PROVISIONAL — the last hand-written key was wrong more often than the model was, so mismatches are read as prompts to inspect, not as model failures.

questions.q: I am a salaried manager in California earning $70,000. Am I owed overtime?
questions.why: CA sets the exempt salary floor at twice the state minimum wage for full-time work, which lands near $70,000 — so state law, not federal, decides this.

questions.q: My employer pays me every two weeks. Is that legal?
questions.why: Lab. Code 204 sets pay frequency. Federal law is silent, so loading CA converts this from a decline into an answer.

questions.q: Am I owed double time for working a Sunday?
questions.why: Lab. Code 510 covers seventh-consecutive-day and over-12-hour premiums; Sunday as such is not special.

questions.q: My employer did not give me my final paycheck when I quit. What can I do?
questions.why: Lab. Code 202 sets the deadline and 203 the waiting-time penalty.

questions.q: I am 16 and work 30 hours a week during school. Is that allowed?
questions.why: Child labour is in neither corpus.

questions.q: Can my employer make me work twelve-hour shifts?
questions.why: Lab. Code 510 requires double time beyond 12 hours.

questions.q: I was misclassified as a contractor. Can I sue for back overtime?
questions.why: 2775 supplies the ABC test and 1194 a right of action, but limitation periods and procedure are absent.

questions.q: Can my employer cut my hours so I lose my health benefits?
questions.why: Benefits eligibility is ERISA and the ACA, in neither corpus.

questions.q: My tips were pooled with the kitchen staff. Is that legal?
questions.why: Lab. Code 351 bars the employer taking any gratuity.

questions.q: Do I get paid for a fifteen minute coffee break?
questions.why: Honest gap: CA rest periods are created by the IWC Wage Orders, which this corpus does NOT contain. 226.7 only supplies the premium for denying one.

questions.q: My employer requires unpaid training on Saturdays. Is that legal?
questions.why: Training time is federal 785; CA overtime applies on top.

questions.q: I am an undocumented worker. Am I still owed the minimum wage?
questions.why: Lab. Code 1171.5 is the express CA provision and was not fetched; immigration consequences are outside both.
